minutes.headline: Commission still can't distribute any trust fund money until legal review is finished, likely early 2026.
minutes.summary: The two-member Trust Fund Commission reviewed correspondence with the town manager about getting its funds-distribution application legally vetted, discussed which older trust declarations (American Legion, worthy poor, gazebo, sidewalk funds) need attorney and possibly probate-court review before language can be updated, and began line-by-line editing of its risk management policy. No funds can be distributed yet; the board also noted a standing vacancy for a third commissioner and set its next meeting date.

votes.motion: Adopt the minutes of the November 13, 2025 meeting as written (with the date correction discussed)

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said this fund is under 20 years old, so a cy pres change requires a probate court filing rather than the Attorney General's office, and cited differing balance figures while noting he was rounding.
The chair said this fund had built up to a large balance over 25-30 years without being used to help residents in need, and that its existence was barely mentioned in past records.
A commissioner cited the fund's balance and discussed whether the money could be used for restoration, painting, or community programming rather than sitting unused.

decisions.decision: Funding applications will be handled on a rolling basis via specially called meetings and executive session as needed, rather than waiting for the regular schedule, with 48-hour public notice.
Proposed modifications to fund declarations will be included in the body of the posted agenda, and posted to the town website, so the public can review them before a public hearing.
Further line-by-line editing of the risk management policy (starting from the trust administrative memo section) is deferred to a future meeting.
Next meeting set for December 11, 2025, the commission's regular second-Thursday date.

what_happened.line: No trust fund money can be distributed until a legal review of the distribution application is finished, expected early 2026.
The commission decided to handle funding applications on a rolling basis through specially called meetings, not the regular monthly schedule.
Members discussed which older trust declarations, including the American Legion, worthy poor, gazebo and sidewalk funds, need attorney or probate-court review before their language can be updated.
Further line-by-line editing of the risk management policy was deferred to a future meeting.
The next meeting was set for December 11, 2025, the commission's regular second-Thursday date.

why_it_matters: Residents or veterans hoping to draw on funds like the American Legion or worthy poor trusts should not expect any distribution before early 2026, since legal review of the application process is still pending.

Any proposed change to a trust fund's founding language will be posted in the agenda and on the town website before a public hearing, giving residents a chance to weigh in before century-old declarations are amended.
A standing vacancy for a third commissioner remains open, leaving the board at two members while it works through legal and policy questions.
